tests: The simplest way to allow content only in licensed countries when delivering through CloudFront.
expected: Enable CloudFront geo-restriction (allow-list of licensed countries). Triggers: "distribution rights by country", "block the rest", "CloudFront".
why_not: Route 53 geoproximity shifts traffic by distance/bias, it does not block; IAM is for AWS principals, not anonymous viewers; signed cookies control who is granted access, not which country.
